entries.name: GapCVP.Core.satisfiable_of_common_valuation_root
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommMonoidWithZero Γ₀] (formula : GapCVP.Core.Formula) (valuation : Fin formula.variableCount → Valuation E Γ₀) (commonRoot : E) (localAssignment : Fin formula.clauses.length → Fin formula.variableCount → Bool), (∀ (C : Fin formula.clauses.length), (formula.clauses.get C).Satisfied (localAssignment C) = true) → (∀ (C : Fin formula.clauses.length), ∀ literal ∈ (formula.clauses.get C).literals, (valuation literal.variableIndex) (commonRoot - GapCVP.Core.bitInField (localAssignment C literal.variableIndex)) < 1) → formula.Satisfiable = true

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.shiftedGenericRootMoment_eq_mappedShiftedPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra k E] [inst_3 : Algebra (Polynomial k) E] [IsScalarTower k (Polynomial k) E] (moments : ℕ → Polynomial k) (shifted : Polynomial k) (variablePlace bit : k) (j : ℕ) {h : ℕ} (roots : Fin h → E), Function.Injective roots → (algebraMap (Polynomial k) E) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C variablePlace) ≠ 0 → (∀ l ≤ j, (algebraMap (Polynomial k) E) (moments l) = GapCVP.Core.rootMoment roots l) → (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C variablePlace) ^ j * shifted = GapCVP.Core.shiftedMomentCombination moments bit j → GapCVP.Core.rootMoment (fun i => (roots i - (algebraMap k E) bit) / (algebraMap (Polynomial k) E) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C variablePlace)) j = (algebraMap (Polynomial k) E) shifted

entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) (points : Finset K) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (tableType : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableType F) (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points) (j : ℕ), (GapCVP.Core.sourceOrdinaryMomentMap F points tableType j) (fun position => (algebraMap (ZMod 2) K) ↑(z position)) point = GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z tableType point) j

entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ), (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true → ∀ (tableType : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableType F), ∀ j ≤ momentBudget, ∃ polynomial, polynomial.natDegree ≤ F.variableCount * j ∧ ∀ (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points), Polynomial.eval (↑point) polynomial = GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z tableType point) j

entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (hz : (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true) (tableType : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableType F) (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points), ∀ j ≤ momentBudget, Polynomial.eval (↑point) (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedOrdinaryMomentPolynomials F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget z hz tableType j) = GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z tableType point) j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedOrdinaryMomentPolynomials_natDegree
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (hz : (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true) (tableType : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableType F) (j : ℕ), (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedOrdinaryMomentPolynomials F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget z hz tableType j).natDegree ≤ F.variableCount * j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedShiftedMomentPolynomials
entries.statement: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] → [inst_2 : Fintype K] → (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) → {e : ℕ} → (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) → (points : Finset K) → (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) → (momentBudget : ℕ) → (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) → (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true → (clause : Fin F.clauses.length) → (F.clauses.get clause).SatisfyingLocalTuple → (F.clauses.get clause).LocalVariable → ℕ → Polynomial K

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedShiftedMomentPolynomials_eval
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (hz : (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true) (clause : Fin F.clauses.length) (tuple : (F.clauses.get clause).SatisfyingLocalTuple) (localVar : (F.clauses.get clause).LocalVariable), ∀ j ≤ momentBudget, ∀ (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points), Polynomial.eval (↑point) (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedShiftedMomentPolynomials F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget z hz clause tuple localVar j) = ∑ value ∈ GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z (Sum.inr ⟨clause, tuple⟩) point, ((value - GapCVP.Core.sourceSATFieldBit (↑tuple localVar)) / (↑point - variablePlace ↑localVar)) ^ j

entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (hz : (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true) (clause : Fin F.clauses.length) (tuple : (F.clauses.get clause).SatisfyingLocalTuple) (localVar : (F.clauses.get clause).LocalVariable) (j : ℕ), (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedShiftedMomentPolynomials F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget z hz clause tuple localVar j).natDegree ≤ (F.variableCount - 1) * j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedShiftedMoment_eq_fiberPowerSum
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (clause : Fin F.clauses.length) (tuple : (F.clauses.get clause).SatisfyingLocalTuple) (localVar : (F.clauses.get clause).LocalVariable) (j : ℕ) (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points), (GapCVP.Core.sourceShiftedMomentMap F points variablePlace clause tuple localVar j) (fun position => (algebraMap (ZMod 2) K) ↑(z position)) point = ∑ value ∈ GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z (Sum.inr ⟨clause, tuple⟩) point, ((value - GapCVP.Core.sourceSATFieldBit (↑tuple localVar)) / (↑point - variablePlace ↑localVar)) ^ j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSigned_exists_shiftedMomentPolynomial
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ), (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true → ∀ (clause : Fin F.clauses.length) (tuple : (F.clauses.get clause).SatisfyingLocalTuple) (localVar : (F.clauses.get clause).LocalVariable), ∀ j ≤ momentBudget, ∃ moment, moment.natDegree ≤ (F.variableCount - 1) * j ∧ ∀ (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points), Polynomial.eval (↑point) moment = ∑ value ∈ GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z (Sum.inr ⟨clause, tuple⟩) point, ((value - GapCVP.Core.sourceSATFieldBit (↑tuple localVar)) / (↑point - variablePlace ↑localVar)) ^ j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSigned_globalSupportMoment_eq_clauseSubtypeSum
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ), (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true → ∀ (clause : Fin F.clauses.length) (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points) (j : ℕ), GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z (Sum.inl ()) point) j = ∑ tuple, GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z (Sum.inr ⟨clause, tuple⟩) point) j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSigned_globalSupportMoment_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ), (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true → ∀ (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points), GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedFiberSupport F points z (Sum.inl ()) point) 0 = 1

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSigned_scaledShiftedMoment_natDegree
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (hz : (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true) (clause : Fin F.clauses.length) (tuple : (F.clauses.get clause).SatisfyingLocalTuple) (localVar : (F.clauses.get clause).LocalVariable) (j : ℕ), ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (variablePlace ↑localVar)) ^ j * GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedShiftedMomentPolynomials F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget z hz clause tuple localVar j).natDegree ≤ F.variableCount * j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSigned_shiftedMomentCombination_natDegree
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (hz : (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true) (tableType : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableType F) (bit : K) (j : ℕ), (GapCVP.Core.shiftedMomentCombination (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedOrdinaryMomentPolynomials F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget z hz tableType) bit j).natDegree ≤ F.variableCount * j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.sourceSigned_shiftedMomentPolynomial_identity
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [inst_2 : Fintype K] (F : GapCVP.Core.Formula) {e : ℕ} (fieldBasis : Module.Basis (Fin e) (ZMod 2) K) (points : Finset K) (variablePlace : Fin F.variableCount → K) (momentBudget : ℕ) (z : Fin (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATTableDimension F K points) → ℤ) (hz : (GapCVP.Core.concreteSATBinaryAffineSystem F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget).Solves z = true) (clause : Fin F.clauses.length) (tuple : (F.clauses.get clause).SatisfyingLocalTuple) (localVar : (F.clauses.get clause).LocalVariable), ∀ j ≤ momentBudget, (∀ (point : GapCVP.Core.sourceSATGridPoint points), ↑point - variablePlace ↑localVar ≠ 0) → F.variableCount * j < points.card → (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (variablePlace ↑localVar)) ^ j * GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedShiftedMomentPolynomials F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget z hz clause tuple localVar j = GapCVP.Core.shiftedMomentCombination (GapCVP.Core.sourceSignedOrdinaryMomentPolynomials F fieldBasis points variablePlace momentBudget z hz (Sum.inr ⟨clause, tuple⟩)) (GapCVP.Core.sourceSATFieldBit (↑tuple localVar)) j

entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (moments : ℕ → Polynomial K) {N d h : ℕ}, d ≤ N → h ≤ N ^ 4 → (∀ (j : ℕ), (moments j).natDegree ≤ d * j) → (GapCVP.Core.genericHankelDenominator h moments).natDegree ≤ N ^ 9

entries.statement: ∀ {N q ell points : ℕ}, 100 ≤ N → ell ≤ N → points ≤ q → 4 * ((ell + 1) * points) ≤ 8 * q * N

entries.statement: ∀ {N ell theta p q : ℕ}, 100 ≤ N → ell ≤ N → theta ≤ 1 + 8 * ell → p ≤ q → q < 2 * N ^ 200 → theta * p * q ≤ 40 * N ^ 401

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.specializedGenericHankelCoefficient_eq_rootSupportCoefficient
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {h : ℕ} (moments : ℕ → Polynomial K) (point : K) (roots : Fin h → K), Function.Injective roots → (∀ j < 2 * h, Polynomial.eval point (moments j) = GapCVP.Core.rootMoment roots j) → ∀ (i : Fin h), GapCVP.Core.specializedGenericHankelCoefficient h moments point i = GapCVP.Core.rootSupportCoefficients roots i

entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {h : ℕ} (moments : ℕ → Polynomial K) (point : K) (roots : Fin h → K), Function.Injective roots → (∀ j < 2 * h, Polynomial.eval point (moments j) = GapCVP.Core.rootMoment roots j) → GapCVP.Core.specializedGenericMomentSupportPolynomial h moments point = GapCVP.Core.rootSupportPolynomial roots

entries.statement: ∀ {S : Type u_2} [inst : Field S] {h : ℕ} (roots : Fin h → S) (i : Fin h), GapCVP.Core.supportElementaryCoefficients (GapCVP.Core.rootSupportCoefficients roots) i = (Multiset.map roots Finset.univ.val).esymm (↑i + 1)

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.supportMoment
entries.statement: {K : Type u_1} → [Field K] → Finset K → ℕ → K

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.supportMoment_enumeratedRootSupport
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] {h : ℕ} (roots : Fin h → E), Function.Injective roots → ∀ (j : ℕ), GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (GapCVP.Core.enumeratedRootSupport roots) j = GapCVP.Core.rootMoment roots j

entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [CharP K 2] [inst_2 : DecidableEq K] (supports : List (Finset K)) (j : ℕ), GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (GapCVP.Core.paritySupport supports) j = (List.map (fun s => GapCVP.Core.supportMoment s j) supports).sum

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.supportMoment_symmDiff
entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [CharP K 2] [inst_2 : DecidableEq K] (s t : Finset K) (j : ℕ), GapCVP.Core.supportMoment (symmDiff s t) j = GapCVP.Core.supportMoment s j + GapCVP.Core.supportMoment t j

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.support_eq_empty_of_low_moments_eq_zero

entries.name: GapCVP.Core.support_eq_of_low_supportMoments_eq
